LPDDR5-6400_x16.source: full-system boundary (device core + on-die I/O + SoC PHY/controller + refresh). Anchor: Ha 2018 (Stanford PhD, refs/Ha2018) Fig 4.8/4.9 LPDDR4 ~8.5-13 pJ/b device-incl-I/O + ~2-2.5 SoC PHY/controller. Cross-check: O'Connor MICRO 2017 HBM2 3.97 pJ/b (LPDDR5 ~2.3x). See docs/dram-energy/README.md (2026-06-23).

LPDDR5X-8533_x16.source: full-system. LPDDR5 9.0 x ~0.83 LPDDR5X efficiency gain (higher data rate at lower energy/bit). See docs/dram-energy/README.md (2026-06-23).

DDR4-3200_x64.source: full-system, secondary confidence (LPDDR5/5X are the validated focus). Wide terminated x64 bus + memory controller dominate: device-incl-I/O ~15 (O'Connor GDDR5 14.0) + SoC controller. See docs/dram-energy/README.md (2026-06-23).

DDR5-4800_x64.source: full-system, secondary confidence. DDR4 20 x VDD 1.2->1.1V (~0.84 dynamic) + on-die ECC / DFE overhead. See docs/dram-energy/README.md (2026-06-23).
